meta.note: MCP bundle: ballot talks + 12 full talks per teacher; the full set is in the /data dump.

ajahn-nyanamoli.name: Ajahn Nyanamoli Thero
ajahn-nyanamoli.bio: Founder of Hillside Hermitage; ordained in the Thai Theravāda tradition and a monk since 2005, teaching from the early suttas.
ajahn-nyanamoli.tagline: Right view, sense restraint and the danger in sensuality, straight from the suttas.

bhikkhu-anigha.name: Bhikkhu Anīgha
bhikkhu-anigha.bio: Monk of Hillside Hermitage and student of Ajahn Nyanamoli; often his partner in the recorded discussions.

thaniyo-thero.name: Thaniyo Thero
thaniyo-thero.bio: Monk of Hillside Hermitage who prepares the condensed transcripts of its talks.

sister-medhini.name: Sister Medhini
sister-medhini.bio: Nun practising under Ajahn Nyanamoli's guidance; writer for Hillside Hermitage.

rob-burbea.name: Rob Burbea
rob-burbea.bio: English Buddhist teacher at Gaia House, known for emptiness practice, the jhānas and Soulmaking Dharma.

jiddu-krishnamurti.name: Jiddu Krishnamurti
jiddu-krishnamurti.bio: Indian speaker raised by the Theosophical Society, who left it in 1929 to teach that truth is a pathless land; much archive footage survives.

works.title: The Ending of Time (with David Bohm)
Truth is a Pathless Land (dissolution speech)

the-buddha.name: The Buddha
the-buddha.bio: Siddhattha Gotama, the teacher whose discourses are the root of every Buddhist tradition.

image.artist: พระมหาเทวประภาส วชิรญาณเมธี

nanavira-thera.name: Ñāṇavīra Thera
nanavira-thera.bio: British monk in Sri Lanka whose existential reading of the suttas shapes Hillside Hermitage's teaching.

ajahn-chah.name: Ajahn Chah
ajahn-chah.bio: Thai forest master who trained many Western monks and founded Wat Pah Pong's network of monasteries.

freeTexts.title: Ajahn Chah collected talks (Access to Insight index)

ajahn-mun.name: Ajahn Mun
ajahn-mun.bio: Co-founder of the Thai Forest Tradition and teacher of a generation of forest monks.

image.artist: กสิณธร ราชโอรส

dogen.name: Dōgen
dogen.bio: Founder of Sōtō Zen in Japan.

ramana-maharshi.name: Ramana Maharshi
ramana-maharshi.bio: Sage of Arunachala who taught self-enquiry: ask 'Who am I?'.

nisargadatta-maharaj.name: Nisargadatta Maharaj
nisargadatta-maharaj.bio: Bombay teacher of the Inchegeri line whose dialogues in I Am That made 'I am' the doorway to the Absolute.

works.title: Consciousness and the Absolute: The Final Talks (ed. Jean Dunn)

siddharameshwar-maharaj.name: Siddharameshwar Maharaj
siddharameshwar-maharaj.bio: Guru of Nisargadatta Maharaj in the Inchegeri Sampradaya.

ramakrishna.name: Ramakrishna
ramakrishna.bio: Bengali mystic of Dakshineswar who taught that every sincere path reaches the same God.

swami-vivekananda.name: Swami Vivekananda
swami-vivekananda.bio: Ramakrishna's chief disciple, who brought Vedānta to the West.

freeTexts.title: The Complete Works of Swami Vivekananda

image.artist: The original uploader was Dziewa at English Wikipedia.

abhinavagupta.name: Abhinavagupta
abhinavagupta.bio: The great systematiser of Kashmir Shaivism.

mahavatar-babaji.name: Mahavatar Babaji
mahavatar-babaji.bio: The deathless yogi said to have revived Kriya Yoga, known through Yogananda's Autobiography of a Yogi.

lahiri-mahasaya.name: Lahiri Mahasaya
lahiri-mahasaya.bio: Householder yogi who received Kriya Yoga from Babaji.

paramahansa-yogananda.name: Paramahansa Yogananda
paramahansa-yogananda.bio: Founder of the Self-Realization Fellowship and author of Autobiography of a Yogi.

works.title: God Talks with Arjuna: The Bhagavad Gita

jesus.name: Jesus
jesus.bio: The teacher of Nazareth at the centre of Christianity, known through the Gospels.

meister-eckhart.name: Meister Eckhart
meister-eckhart.bio: German Dominican mystic of detachment and the birth of God in the soul.

valentinus.name: Valentinus
valentinus.bio: Alexandrian Christian teacher whose Gnostic school was the most influential of its age.

plato.name: Plato
plato.bio: Athenian philosopher whose dialogues set the soul's ascent to the Good at the heart of Western thought.

plotinus.name: Plotinus
plotinus.bio: Founder of Neoplatonism, who taught the return of the soul to the One.

freeTexts.title: Plotinos: Complete Works (4 vols)
An Essay on the Beautiful (Ennead I.6)

proclus.name: Proclus
proclus.bio: Head of the Platonic Academy in Athens and the great systematiser of late Neoplatonism.

freeTexts.title: The Six Books of Proclus on the Theology of Plato
Philosophical and Mathematical Commentaries of Proclus on Euclid

marsilio-ficino.name: Marsilio Ficino
marsilio-ficino.bio: Florentine priest who translated Plato and Plotinus into Latin and revived Platonism in the Renaissance.

rudolf-steiner.name: Rudolf Steiner
rudolf-steiner.bio: Austrian esotericist who left Theosophy to found Anthroposophy, a path of spiritual science.

george-gurdjieff.name: George Gurdjieff
george-gurdjieff.bio: Teacher of the Fourth Way, a path of self-remembering in ordinary life.

pd-ouspensky.name: P. D. Ouspensky
pd-ouspensky.bio: Russian student of Gurdjieff whose In Search of the Miraculous set out the Fourth Way.

rupert-spira.name: Rupert Spira
rupert-spira.bio: English potter turned teacher of the direct path, who points to awareness as the one reality behind all experience; a student of Francis Lucille.

works.title: You Are the Happiness You Seek

francis-lucille.name: Francis Lucille
francis-lucille.bio: French-born non-dual teacher in the line of Jean Klein, known for dialogues that test every claim against direct experience.

mooji.name: Mooji
mooji.bio: Jamaican-born teacher of self-enquiry who met Papaji in Lucknow in 1993 and now teaches from Monte Sahaja in Portugal.

works.title: Vaster Than Sky, Greater Than Space

adyashanti.name: Adyashanti
adyashanti.bio: American teacher trained in Zen who now teaches awakening outside any one tradition through his Open Gate Sangha.

swami-tadatmananda.name: Swami Tadatmananda
swami-tadatmananda.bio: American-born monk and teacher of Advaita Vedanta and meditation at the Arsha Bodha Center in New Jersey, a disciple of Swami Dayananda Saraswati.

works.title: The Inner Journey: A Course in Meditation

christopher-wallis.name: Christopher Wallis (Hareesh)
christopher-wallis.bio: Sanskrit scholar and practitioner of classical Śaiva Tantra who translates and teaches the non-dual texts of Kashmir Shaivism for modern practice.

swami-lakshmanjoo.name: Swami Lakshmanjoo
swami-lakshmanjoo.bio: Kashmiri master regarded as the last living holder of the oral tradition of Kashmir Shaivism; his recorded teachings are kept by the Lakshmanjoo Academy.

works.title: Vijñāna Bhairava: The Practice of Centring Awareness

david-godman.name: David Godman
david-godman.bio: English writer who has lived at Tiruvannamalai since the 1970s and has written the standard books on Ramana Maharshi, his devotees and Papaji.

works.title: Be As You Are: The Teachings of Sri Ramana Maharshi
Living by the Words of Bhagavan

swami-sarvapriyananda.name: Swami Sarvapriyananda
swami-sarvapriyananda.bio: Monk of the Ramakrishna Order and head of the Vedanta Society of New York, known for clear lectures on Advaita Vedanta and consciousness.

brother-chidananda.name: Brother Chidananda
brother-chidananda.bio: President and spiritual head of Self-Realization Fellowship / Yogoda Satsanga Society of India since 2017, teaching Yogananda's Kriya Yoga path.

works.title: SRF Convocation and online meditation talks

sri-mrinalini-mata.name: Sri Mrinalini Mata
sri-mrinalini-mata.bio: Direct disciple of Paramahansa Yogananda, trained by him to edit his writings, and fourth president of Self-Realization Fellowship.

works.title: Manifesting Divine Consciousness in Daily Life

sri-daya-mata.name: Sri Daya Mata
sri-daya-mata.bio: Direct disciple of Paramahansa Yogananda who led Self-Realization Fellowship as its president for more than fifty years.

brother-anandamoy.name: Brother Anandamoy
brother-anandamoy.bio: Swiss-born monk and direct disciple of Paramahansa Yogananda who lectured for Self-Realization Fellowship for decades.

brother-bhumananda.name: Brother Bhumananda
brother-bhumananda.bio: Monk of the Self-Realization Fellowship order who gives talks and guided practice on Yogananda's teachings.

brother-achalananda.name: Brother Achalananda
brother-achalananda.bio: Monk of the Self-Realization Fellowship order who gives talks and guided practice on Yogananda's teachings.

brother-satyananda.name: Brother Satyananda
brother-satyananda.bio: Monk of the Self-Realization Fellowship order who gives talks and guided practice on Yogananda's teachings.

brother-kamalananda.name: Brother Kamalananda
brother-kamalananda.bio: Monk of the Self-Realization Fellowship order who gives talks and guided practice on Yogananda's teachings.

brother-prafullananda.name: Brother Prafullananda
brother-prafullananda.bio: Monk of the Self-Realization Fellowship order who gives talks and guided practice on Yogananda's teachings.

sister-usha.name: Sister Usha
sister-usha.bio: Nun of the Self-Realization Fellowship order who gives short talks on Yogananda's teachings.

swami-sarvadevananda.name: Swami Sarvadevananda
swami-sarvadevananda.bio: Monk of the Ramakrishna Order and minister of the Vedanta Society of Southern California in Hollywood.

swami-mahayogananda.name: Swami Mahayogananda
swami-mahayogananda.bio: Monk of the Ramakrishna Order at the Vedanta Society of Southern California who speaks on Vedanta, near-death experience and rebirth.

swami-satyamayananda.name: Swami Satyamayananda
swami-satyamayananda.bio: Monk of the Ramakrishna Order whose talks are published by the Vedanta Society of Southern California.

swami-atmaghanananda.name: Swami Atmaghanananda
swami-atmaghanananda.bio: Monk of the Ramakrishna Order whose talks are published by the Vedanta Society of Southern California.

swami-atmavidyananda.name: Swami Atmavidyananda
swami-atmavidyananda.bio: Monk of the Ramakrishna Order whose talks are published by the Vedanta Society of Southern California.

swami-vedarupananda.name: Swami Vedarupananda
swami-vedarupananda.bio: Monk of the Ramakrishna Order whose talks are published by the Vedanta Society of Southern California.

pravrajika-vidyaprana.name: Pravrajika Vidyaprana
pravrajika-vidyaprana.bio: Nun of the Sarada Convent of the Vedanta Society of Southern California who answers questions on Vedanta.

venkat-s-ramanan.name: Dr. Venkat S. Ramanan
venkat-s-ramanan.bio: President of Sri Ramanasramam in Tiruvannamalai (also known as Dr. Anand Ramanan), who speaks on Ramana Maharshi's teaching at the ashram's celebrations.

nochur-venkataraman.name: Sri Nochur Venkataraman
nochur-venkataraman.bio: Vedanta teacher from Kerala known for long talk series on Ramana Maharshi's poems, several given in English at Sri Ramanasramam.

aparna-krishnamoorthy.name: Aparna Krishnamoorthy
aparna-krishnamoorthy.bio: Speaker on the Advaitic meaning of Ramana Maharshi's hymns, in a talk published by Sri Ramanasramam.

ganapathi-raman.name: Ganapathi Raman
ganapathi-raman.bio: Devotee of Ramana Maharshi interviewed for Sri Ramanasramam's devotee-interview series.

dhiruben-patel.name: Dhiruben Patel
dhiruben-patel.bio: Devotee of Ramana Maharshi whose recollections were recorded by Sri Ramanasramam.

santa-ramachandran.name: Dr. Santa Ramachandran
santa-ramachandran.bio: Devotee who recalls moments with Ramana Maharshi in a recording published by Sri Ramanasramam.

mangalam-kalyanam.name: Mangalam Kalyanam
mangalam-kalyanam.bio: Granddaughter of Niranjanananda Swami, the ashram's first sarvadhikari and Ramana Maharshi's younger brother, recorded by Sri Ramanasramam.

sethulakshmi.name: Sethulakshmi
sethulakshmi.bio: Devotee of Ramana Maharshi interviewed for Sri Ramanasramam's devotee-interview series.

sarada-devi.name: Sri Sarada Devi (Holy Mother)
sarada-devi.bio: Wife and spiritual companion of Ramakrishna, revered in the Ramakrishna Order as the Holy Mother.

works.title: The Gospel of the Holy Mother (sayings)

sri-yukteswar.name: Swami Sri Yukteswar Giri
sri-yukteswar.bio: Disciple of Lahiri Mahasaya and the guru of Paramahansa Yogananda.

adi-shankara.name: Ādi Śaṅkara
adi-shankara.bio: Philosopher who set out Advaita Vedanta in commentaries on the Upanishads, Gita and Brahma Sutras.

papaji.name: H. W. L. Poonja (Papaji)
papaji.bio: Disciple of Ramana Maharshi who taught self-enquiry in Lucknow and inspired many Western teachers, Mooji among them.

jean-klein.name: Jean Klein
jean-klein.bio: French musicologist and doctor who taught non-dual listening and body work in Europe and America; teacher of Francis Lucille.

atmananda-krishna-menon.name: Atmananda Krishna Menon
atmananda-krishna-menon.bio: Kerala lawyer and sage whose "direct path" of enquiry into consciousness shaped Jean Klein, Francis Lucille and Rupert Spira.

swami-dayananda-saraswati.name: Swami Dayananda Saraswati
swami-dayananda-saraswati.bio: Teacher of traditional Advaita Vedanta who founded the Arsha Vidya Gurukulams and trained Swami Tadatmananda among many others.

ajahn-brahm.name: Ajahn Brahm
ajahn-brahm.bio: British-born monk trained under Ajahn Chah in Thailand, abbot of Bodhinyana Monastery and spiritual director of the Buddhist Society of Western Australia.
ajahn-brahm.tagline: Jhāna, kindness and rebirth, taught with stories and laughter.

works.title: Opening the Door of Your Heart

ajahn-sumedho.name: Ajahn Sumedho
ajahn-sumedho.bio: American-born senior Western disciple of Ajahn Chah who founded Chithurst and Amaravati monasteries in England and led them for decades.
ajahn-sumedho.tagline: Intuitive awareness and the deathless, here and now.

ajahn-amaro.name: Ajahn Amaro
ajahn-amaro.bio: English monk ordained in Ajahn Chah's lineage, co-founder of Abhayagiri in California and later abbot of Amaravati.
ajahn-amaro.tagline: Forest-tradition practice with a light touch.

works.title: The Island: An Anthology of the Buddha's Teachings on Nibbāna

ajahn-pasanno.name: Ajahn Pasanno
ajahn-pasanno.bio: Canadian monk who trained with Ajahn Chah, served as abbot of Wat Pah Nanachat and then co-abbot of Abhayagiri Buddhist Monastery.
ajahn-pasanno.tagline: Steady forest wisdom on death, fear and letting go.

works.title: The Island: An Anthology of the Buddha's Teachings on Nibbāna

thanissaro-bhikkhu.name: Thanissaro Bhikkhu
thanissaro-bhikkhu.bio: American monk of the Thai forest Kammaṭṭhāna tradition, abbot of Metta Forest Monastery and a prolific translator of the Pāli suttas.
thanissaro-bhikkhu.tagline: Breath, kamma and skilful action, one evening talk at a time.

freeTexts.title: With Each & Every Breath (breath meditation guide)

thich-nhat-hanh.name: Thich Nhat Hanh
thich-nhat-hanh.bio: Vietnamese Zen monk, poet and peace activist who founded the Plum Village tradition and taught mindfulness and interbeing worldwide.
thich-nhat-hanh.tagline: Interbeing, no birth and no death, and the art of mindful living.

works.title: The Heart of the Buddha's Teaching

shunryu-suzuki.name: Shunryu Suzuki
shunryu-suzuki.bio: Japanese Sōtō priest who founded San Francisco Zen Center and Tassajara; his recorded talks shaped Western Zen practice.

image.artist: Tim Buckley, Lynn Good, or Robert Boni

shohaku-okumura.name: Shohaku Okumura
shohaku-okumura.bio: Japanese Sōtō Zen priest and translator of Dōgen, a student of Kōshō Uchiyama, and founding teacher of Sanshin Zen Community in Indiana.
shohaku-okumura.tagline: Reading Dōgen closely, sitting zazen simply.

joan-halifax.name: Joan Halifax
joan-halifax.bio: American Zen teacher, anthropologist and founding abbot of Upaya Zen Center, known for her work on care for the dying.
joan-halifax.tagline: Compassion at the edge: dying, care and engaged practice.

henry-shukman.name: Henry Shukman
henry-shukman.bio: British poet and novelist who became a Sanbō Zen teacher and guiding teacher of Mountain Cloud Zen Center in Santa Fe.

brad-warner.name: Brad Warner
brad-warner.bio: American Sōtō Zen priest, author and former punk bassist who received transmission from Gudō Nishijima.

shinge-roshi.name: Shinge Roshi
shinge-roshi.bio: Shinge Roko Sherry Chayat, American Rinzai Zen teacher and abbot of the Zen Studies Society (Dai Bosatsu Zendo and New York Zendo).
shinge-roshi.tagline: Rinzai sesshin talks from Dai Bosatsu.

works.title: Subtle Sound: The Zen Teachings of Maurine Stuart (editor)

mingyur-rinpoche.name: Yongey Mingyur Rinpoche
mingyur-rinpoche.bio: Tibetan Kagyu and Nyingma teacher who founded Tergar, known for pairing meditation instruction with neuroscience and for a years-long wandering retreat.
mingyur-rinpoche.tagline: Awareness, the joy of living, and what happens when we die.

dalai-lama.name: The 14th Dalai Lama
dalai-lama.bio: Tenzin Gyatso, the 14th Dalai Lama, a Gelug monk and scholar who has taught compassion and secular ethics worldwide from exile in Dharamsala.

tsoknyi-rinpoche.name: Tsoknyi Rinpoche
tsoknyi-rinpoche.bio: Tibetan Drukpa Kagyu and Nyingma teacher, son of Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche, whose teaching on essence love and the subtle body works with modern stress.
tsoknyi-rinpoche.tagline: Essence love, handshake practice and open awareness.

image.artist: Festival of Faiths from Louisville, United States

tara-brach.name: Tara Brach
tara-brach.bio: American psychologist and Insight meditation teacher who founded the Insight Meditation Community of Washington.
tara-brach.tagline: Radical acceptance and the RAIN practice.

jack-kornfield.name: Jack Kornfield
jack-kornfield.bio: American teacher who trained as a monk under Ajahn Chah and Mahasi Sayadaw, co-founded the Insight Meditation Society and Spirit Rock.
jack-kornfield.tagline: Heart-centred insight practice for ordinary life.

gil-fronsdal.name: Gil Fronsdal
gil-fronsdal.bio: Insight and Sōtō Zen-trained teacher who leads the Insight Meditation Center in Redwood City and translated the Dhammapada.
gil-fronsdal.tagline: Plain-spoken mindfulness and the path to freedom.

joseph-goldstein.name: Joseph Goldstein
joseph-goldstein.bio: American Insight meditation teacher and co-founder of the Insight Meditation Society in Barre, Massachusetts.

works.title: Mindfulness: A Practical Guide to Awakening

sharon-salzberg.name: Sharon Salzberg
sharon-salzberg.bio: American teacher and co-founder of the Insight Meditation Society, best known for bringing mettā (lovingkindness) practice to the West.

image.artist: Christopher Michel from San Francisco, USA

pa-auk-sayadaw.name: Pa-Auk Sayadaw
pa-auk-sayadaw.bio: Bhaddanta Āciṇṇa, Burmese abbot of Pa-Auk Forest Monastery, who teaches a detailed samatha-and-vipassanā system based on the Visuddhimagga.

nagarjuna.name: Nāgārjuna
nagarjuna.bio: Indian Buddhist philosopher who founded the Madhyamaka school and set out emptiness as the middle way between being and non-being.

kosho-uchiyama.name: Kōshō Uchiyama
kosho-uchiyama.bio: Japanese Sōtō priest and abbot of Antaiji who taught a plain, sesshin-centred zazen; teacher of Shohaku Okumura.

goenka.name: S. N. Goenka
goenka.bio: Burmese-Indian lay teacher in the lineage of U Ba Khin whose ten-day vipassanā courses spread worldwide.

mahasi-sayadaw.name: Mahasi Sayadaw
mahasi-sayadaw.bio: Burmese monk whose noting method of satipaṭṭhāna became the backbone of the modern Insight movement.

freeTexts.title: Satipatthana Vipassana

ajaan-lee.name: Ajaan Lee Dhammadharo
ajaan-lee.bio: Thai forest monk, student of Ajahn Mun, whose breath-meditation method Thanissaro Bhikkhu translated and teaches.

freeTexts.title: Ajaan Lee Dhammadharo (ATI index)

tulku-urgyen.name: Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche
tulku-urgyen.bio: Tibetan Kagyu and Nyingma master of Dzogchen and Mahāmudrā, father and teacher of Mingyur and Tsoknyi Rinpoche.

zhaozhou.name: Zhaozhou Congshen
zhaozhou.bio: Tang-dynasty Chan master whose answer "Mu" to a question about a dog's Buddha-nature became the first case of the Gateless Gate.

socrates.name: Socrates
socrates.bio: Athenian philosopher known through Plato and Xenophon; made self-examination and the care of the soul the work of philosophy.

pythagoras.name: Pythagoras
pythagoras.bio: Founder of a religious-philosophical community in southern Italy, remembered for number mysticism and the transmigration of souls.

image.artist: The original uploader was Galilea at German Wikipedia.

pseudo-dionysius.name: Pseudo-Dionysius the Areopagite
pseudo-dionysius.bio: Anonymous Christian Neoplatonist whose writings on the divine names and knowing God by unknowing shaped Christian mysticism.

marguerite-porete.name: Marguerite Porete
marguerite-porete.bio: Beguine mystic burned for heresy in Paris; her book describes the soul annihilated in divine love.

jakob-boehme.name: Jakob Böhme
jakob-boehme.bio: Shoemaker of Görlitz whose visionary writings on the divine abyss founded Christian theosophy.

freeTexts.title: Dialogues on the Supersensual Life

helena-blavatsky.name: Helena Blavatsky
helena-blavatsky.bio: Russian-born occultist who co-founded the Theosophical Society and spread ideas of karma and reincarnation in the West.

mary-magdalene.name: Mary Magdalene
mary-magdalene.bio: Follower of Jesus and witness of the resurrection; the Gospel of Mary presents her as receiver of secret teaching on the soul's ascent.

justin-sledge.name: Justin Sledge
justin-sledge.bio: Historian of philosophy and religion who presents ESOTERICA, a channel on the history of mysticism, Gnosticism and Hermeticism.

works.title: Being and Logos: Introduction to Middle Platonism

filip-holm.name: Filip Holm
filip-holm.bio: Swedish scholar of religion and educator who runs Let's Talk Religion, long-form videos on mysticism across traditions.

john-vervaeke.name: John Vervaeke
john-vervaeke.bio: Cognitive scientist at the University of Toronto whose lecture series traces wisdom from Socrates and Plato through Gnosis and Neoplatonism.

charles-stang.name: Charles Stang
charles-stang.bio: Harvard Divinity School scholar of early Christian mysticism, heard here in dialogue with John Vervaeke on daimons and the higher self.

gregory-sadler.name: Gregory B. Sadler
gregory-sadler.bio: Philosophy educator whose short 'Core Concepts' lectures walk through Plato's dialogues passage by passage.

pierre-grimes.name: Pierre Grimes
pierre-grimes.bio: Platonist philosopher and founder of the Noetic Society, who read Plato, Plotinus and Proclus as a living practice he called philosophical midwifery.

michael-sugrue.name: Michael Sugrue
michael-sugrue.bio: American historian whose Great Minds lectures on Plato and the Western canon became widely watched online.

works.title: Great Minds of the Western Intellectual Tradition

eric-steinhart.name: Eric Steinhart
eric-steinhart.bio: Philosophy professor whose short lectures explain Plotinus' One, emanation and the soul's fall and return.

denis-robichaud.name: Denis Robichaud
denis-robichaud.bio: Historian of Renaissance philosophy and author of a study of Ficino's Plato, speaking at the Lumen Christi Institute.

works.title: Plato's Persona: Marsilio Ficino, Renaissance Humanism, and Platonic Traditions

richard-rohr.name: Richard Rohr
richard-rohr.bio: Franciscan friar and founder of the Center for Action and Contemplation, teaching the contemplative mind and the Universal Christ.

cynthia-bourgeault.name: Cynthia Bourgeault
cynthia-bourgeault.bio: Episcopal priest and teacher of Centering Prayer and Wisdom Christianity who draws openly on Gurdjieff's Work.

image.artist: Festival of Faiths from Louisville, United States

works.title: The Holy Trinity and the Law of Three

barbara-holmes.name: Barbara A. Holmes
barbara-holmes.bio: Writer and teacher on African American mysticism and contemplative practice, a CAC core faculty member.

works.title: Joy Unspeakable: Contemplative Practices of the Black Church

theodore-nottingham.name: Theodore Nottingham
theodore-nottingham.bio: Author and teacher who presents Gurdjieff's Fourth Way alongside the Christian contemplative tradition on his own channel.

works.title: Fourth Way and inner Christianity talks

jacob-needleman.name: Jacob Needleman
jacob-needleman.bio: Philosopher at San Francisco State and long-time member of the Gurdjieff Work, writer on lost Christianity and the inner life.

gary-lachman.name: Gary Lachman
gary-lachman.bio: Writer on consciousness and the Western esoteric tradition, author of studies of Ouspensky, Steiner and Blavatsky.

works.title: In Search of P. D. Ouspensky
Rudolf Steiner: An Introduction to His Life and Work

mitch-horowitz.name: Mitch Horowitz
mitch-horowitz.bio: Historian of alternative spirituality and writer on New Thought, Gnosticism and Gurdjieff.

pablo-sender.name: Pablo Sender
pablo-sender.bio: Theosophical Society speaker and author who teaches Blavatsky's approach to meditation and the inner self.

john-dalton.name: John Dalton
john-dalton.bio: Speaker at the Theosophical Society in England and Wales on Rudolf Steiner's indications for the future.

bart-ehrman.name: Bart D. Ehrman
bart-ehrman.bio: New Testament scholar at UNC Chapel Hill who writes on early Christian diversity, including the Gnostics.

anandamayi-ma.name: Anandamayi Ma
anandamayi-ma.bio: Bengali saint, born Nirmala Sundari in present-day Bangladesh, whose spontaneous states of absorption drew devotees across India for six decades; she taught that all is God and that turning towards God is the one duty.

image.artist: The original uploader was Louperivois at French Wikipedia.

works.title: Matri Vani (sayings, compiled by her ashram)
Words of Sri Anandamayi Ma (tr. Atmananda)

ramesh-balsekar.name: Ramesh Balsekar
ramesh-balsekar.bio: Retired president of the Bank of India who translated for Nisargadatta Maharaj in his last years and then taught in Bombay that there is no individual doer and that everything happens by the will of the Source.

gautam-sachdeva.name: Gautam Sachdeva
gautam-sachdeva.bio: Mumbai-based author and publisher, a long-time student of Ramesh Balsekar, who retells stories and pointers from Ramesh, Nisargadatta and Siddharameshwar in short talks.

wayne-liquorman.name: Wayne Liquorman
wayne-liquorman.bio: American teacher and former businessman who met Ramesh Balsekar in 1987, published his books, and teaches non-doership through the Advaita Fellowship.

works.title: Enlightenment Is Not What You Think

sri-ranjit-maharaj.name: Sri Ranjit Maharaj
sri-ranjit-maharaj.bio: Fellow disciple of Siddharameshwar Maharaj alongside Nisargadatta, who taught in Bombay and in Europe late in life that everything is illusion and only the Self is real.

stephen-wolinsky.name: Stephen Wolinsky
stephen-wolinsky.bio: American psychologist and writer who sat with Nisargadatta Maharaj in 1979–81 and later made the film Rays of the Absolute about his legacy.

works.title: Rays of the Absolute (film, with Science and Nonduality)

s-k-mullarpattan.name: S. K. Mullarpattan
s-k-mullarpattan.bio: One of the main interpreters at Nisargadatta Maharaj's Bombay talks, interviewed in Rays of the Absolute.

vanaja-narayanswamy.name: Dr. Vanaja Narayanswamy
vanaja-narayanswamy.bio: Disciple of Nisargadatta Maharaj interviewed in Rays of the Absolute.

jean-dunn.name: Jean Dunn
jean-dunn.bio: American disciple of Nisargadatta Maharaj who recorded and edited his last talks into three books.

atmananda-blanca-schlamm.name: Atmananda (Blanca Schlamm)
atmananda-blanca-schlamm.bio: Austrian-born pianist who lived with Anandamayi Ma for decades as a brahmacharini and translated her sayings into English; interviewed in 1981.

swami-chidananda-saraswati.name: Swami Chidananda
swami-chidananda-saraswati.bio: Successor of Swami Sivananda as president of the Divine Life Society in Rishikesh and a close friend of Anandamayi Ma.

swami-kedarnath.name: Swami Kedarnath
swami-kedarnath.bio: Monk of Sri Sri Mata Anandamayi Peeth, Indore, who explains Anandamayi Ma's teaching in English.

swami-vijayananda.name: Swami Vijayananda
swami-vijayananda.bio: French physician (born Adolphe Weintrob) who came to Anandamayi Ma in 1951 and lived as a monk in her ashrams for nearly sixty years.

works.title: A French Doctor in the Himalayas

shunyamurti.name: Shunyamurti
shunyamurti.bio: Teacher and founder of the Sat Yoga Institute in Costa Rica; here he reads Yogananda's account of meeting Anandamayi Ma.

swami-sivananda.name: Swami Sivananda
swami-sivananda.bio: Physician turned monk who founded the Divine Life Society in Rishikesh, teaching a synthesis of yoga paths: serve, love, meditate, realise.

ajahn-sao.name: Ajahn Sao Kantasīlo
ajahn-sao.bio: Thai forest monk who taught Ajahn Mun and is counted as a co-founder of the Thai Forest tradition.

image.artist: วัดภูเขาแก้ว

ajahn-fuang.name: Ajaan Fuang Jotiko
ajahn-fuang.bio: Student of Ajaan Lee who led Wat Dhammasathit and trained Thanissaro Bhikkhu.

ajahn-maha-boowa.name: Ajahn Mahā Boowa
ajahn-maha-boowa.bio: Senior disciple of Ajahn Mun, founder of Wat Pa Ban Taad and author of Mun's best-known biography.

freeTexts.title: Ajahn Maha Boowa talks and books (ATI index)

image.artist: กสิณธร ราชโอรส

ajahn-thate.name: Ajahn Thate Desaransi
ajahn-thate.bio: Long-lived forest master and Mun disciple, abbot of Wat Hin Mak Peng on the Mekong.

ajahn-liem.name: Ajahn Liem Ṭhitadhammo
ajahn-liem.bio: Ajahn Chah's successor as abbot of Wat Nong Pah Pong.

ajahn-jayasaro.name: Ajahn Jayasāro
ajahn-jayasaro.bio: English-born monk of Ajahn Chah's line, former abbot of Wat Pah Nanachat, who teaches widely in Thai.

ajahn-viradhammo.name: Ajahn Viradhammo
ajahn-viradhammo.bio: Canadian-born disciple of Ajahn Chah and abbot of Tisarana Monastery in Ontario.

ajahn-munindo.name: Ajahn Munindo
ajahn-munindo.bio: New Zealand-born monk of Ajahn Chah's line who led Aruna Ratanagiri in Northumberland for decades.

ajahn-sucitto.name: Ajahn Sucitto
ajahn-sucitto.bio: English monk who trained with Ajahn Sumedho and was long abbot of Cittaviveka.

buddhadasa.name: Buddhadāsa Bhikkhu
buddhadasa.bio: Reforming Thai monk-scholar who founded Suan Mokkh and stressed emptiness and practice in daily life.

ledi-sayadaw.name: Ledi Sayadaw
ledi-sayadaw.bio: Burmese scholar-monk who began teaching insight meditation to lay people around 1900.

saya-thetgyi.name: Saya Thetgyi
saya-thetgyi.bio: Farmer and lay teacher, a student of Ledi Sayadaw, who taught U Ba Khin.

u-ba-khin.name: Sayagyi U Ba Khin
u-ba-khin.bio: Burmese civil servant and lay meditation teacher whose students included S. N. Goenka.

sayamagyi.name: Mother Sayamagyi
sayamagyi.bio: Senior disciple of U Ba Khin who carried his teaching to the International Meditation Centres abroad.

mingun-sayadaw.name: Mingun Jetavana Sayadaw
mingun-sayadaw.bio: Burmese meditation master who taught Mahasi Sayadaw.

sayadaw-u-pandita.name: Sayadaw U Paṇḍita
sayadaw-u-pandita.bio: Strict successor in the Mahasi line who trained many Western insight teachers.

chanmyay-sayadaw.name: Chanmyay Sayadaw (U Janaka)
chanmyay-sayadaw.bio: Mahasi-lineage teacher who founded Chanmyay Yeiktha and taught abroad for decades.

anagarika-munindra.name: Anagarika Munindra
anagarika-munindra.bio: Bengali meditation teacher trained under Mahasi Sayadaw who taught Goldstein, Dipa Ma and others in Bodh Gaya.

dipa-ma.name: Dipa Ma
dipa-ma.bio: Bengali householder and renowned meditator, a mentor to Sharon Salzberg and Joseph Goldstein.

shwe-oo-min-sayadaw.name: Shwe Oo Min Sayadaw
shwe-oo-min-sayadaw.bio: Burmese master whose relaxed mindfulness approach Sayadaw U Tejaniya carries on.

sayadaw-u-tejaniya.name: Sayadaw U Tejaniya
sayadaw-u-tejaniya.bio: Burmese teacher known for a gentle 'awareness of the mind' style of insight practice.

freeTexts.title: Teachings and free books (Right Attitude; Don't Look Down on the Defilements…)

bhante-gunaratana.name: Bhante Henepola Gunaratana
bhante-gunaratana.bio: Sri Lankan monk, author of Mindfulness in Plain English and founder of the Bhavana Society.

nyanatiloka.name: Nyanatiloka Mahathera
nyanatiloka.bio: German pioneer monk who founded the Island Hermitage in Sri Lanka.

nyanaponika.name: Nyanaponika Thera
nyanaponika.bio: German-born monk, author of The Heart of Buddhist Meditation and co-founder of the Buddhist Publication Society.

freeTexts.title: The Five Mental Hindrances and Their Conquest

bhikkhu-bodhi.name: Bhikkhu Bodhi
bhikkhu-bodhi.bio: American monk and translator of the Pali Nikayas, long editor at the Buddhist Publication Society.

freeTexts.title: The Noble Eightfold Path: The Way to the End of Suffering

tsongkhapa.name: Je Tsongkhapa
tsongkhapa.bio: Fourteenth-century Tibetan master whose reforms founded the Gelug school.

ling-rinpoche.name: Kyabje Ling Rinpoche (6th)
ling-rinpoche.bio: Senior tutor of the 14th Dalai Lama and Ganden Tripa.

trijang-rinpoche.name: Kyabje Trijang Rinpoche (3rd)
trijang-rinpoche.bio: Junior tutor of the 14th Dalai Lama.

image.artist: Evan Osherow from Bowie, AZ, USA

lama-yeshe.name: Lama Thubten Yeshe
lama-yeshe.bio: Tibetan lama who with Lama Zopa founded Kopan and the FPMT network.

lama-zopa.name: Lama Zopa Rinpoche
lama-zopa.bio: Sherpa lama, co-founder of Kopan and long-time spiritual director of the FPMT.

tilopa.name: Tilopa
tilopa.bio: Indian mahasiddha at the head of the Kagyu lineage of mahamudra.

image.artist: Original uploader was גלגל האש at he.wikipedia

naropa.name: Naropa
naropa.bio: Nalanda scholar turned yogi, Tilopa's disciple and source of the Six Yogas.

marpa.name: Marpa the Translator
marpa.bio: Tibetan householder-translator who brought Naropa's teachings to Tibet.

gampopa.name: Gampopa
gampopa.bio: Physician-monk who joined Milarepa's yoga with Kadampa monasticism.

karmapa-1.name: Düsum Khyenpa, 1st Karmapa
karmapa-1.bio: Gampopa's disciple and the first Karmapa, founder of Tsurphu.

karmapa-16.name: Rangjung Rigpe Dorje, 16th Karmapa
karmapa-16.bio: Head of the Karma Kagyu who re-established the school in exile at Rumtek and brought it to the West.

image.artist: an employee of the Austrian Buddhist society

karmapa-17.name: Ogyen Trinley Dorje, 17th Karmapa
karmapa-17.bio: Recognised as the 17th Karmapa by the Dalai Lama and most Kagyu authorities; a rival candidate also exists.

akong-rinpoche.name: Akong Tulku Rinpoche
akong-rinpoche.bio: Co-founder and long-time abbot of Samye Ling in Scotland.

chogyam-trungpa.name: Chögyam Trungpa Rinpoche
chogyam-trungpa.bio: Tibetan teacher who co-founded Samye Ling, then founded Naropa University and Shambhala in North America.

pema-chodron.name: Pema Chödrön
pema-chodron.bio: American nun and author, a student of Chögyam Trungpa, resident teacher at Gampo Abbey.

chokyi-nyima-rinpoche.name: Chökyi Nyima Rinpoche
chokyi-nyima-rinpoche.bio: Eldest son of Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche and abbot of Ka-Nying Shedrub Ling in Boudha.

padmasambhava.name: Padmasambhava (Guru Rinpoche)
padmasambhava.bio: Eighth-century tantric master credited with establishing Buddhism in Tibet.

gyokujun-so-on.name: Gyokujun So-on Suzuki
gyokujun-so-on.bio: Soto priest who ordained Shunryu Suzuki and gave him dharma transmission.

kishizawa-ian.name: Kishizawa Ian
kishizawa-ian.bio: Soto scholar-teacher who further trained Shunryu Suzuki in Dogen's Shobogenzo.

richard-baker.name: Zentatsu Richard Baker
richard-baker.bio: Shunryu Suzuki's dharma heir and second abbot of San Francisco Zen Center.

kodo-sawaki.name: Kōdō Sawaki
kodo-sawaki.bio: Itinerant Soto master who stressed zazen alone ('homeless Kodo'); teacher of Kosho Uchiyama.

gudo-nishijima.name: Gudō Wafu Nishijima
gudo-nishijima.bio: Japanese Zen teacher and Shobogenzo translator, Brad Warner's teacher.

image.artist: Permission granted by James M. Cohen, Attorney at Law

hakuun-yasutani.name: Hakuun Yasutani
hakuun-yasutani.bio: Founder of the Sanbo Kyodan, who taught Philip Kapleau and Taizan Maezumi.

taizan-maezumi.name: Taizan Maezumi
taizan-maezumi.bio: Founder of the Zen Center of Los Angeles; many American teachers are his heirs.

bernie-glassman.name: Bernie Glassman
bernie-glassman.bio: Maezumi's first heir, founder of the Zen Peacemakers and teacher of Joan Halifax.

image.artist: Stephanie Young Merzel from Salt Lake City, Utah, USA

john-daido-loori.name: John Daido Loori
john-daido-loori.bio: Maezumi heir who founded Zen Mountain Monastery.

philip-kapleau.name: Philip Kapleau
philip-kapleau.bio: Author of The Three Pillars of Zen and founder of the Rochester Zen Center.

image.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Mind meal~commonswiki assumed

eido-shimano.name: Eido Shimano
eido-shimano.bio: Rinzai teacher who founded Dai Bosatsu Zendo; he resigned in 2010 after misconduct revelations.

bodhidharma.name: Bodhidharma
bodhidharma.bio: Legendary Indian monk honoured as the first patriarch of Chan.

huineng.name: Huineng
huineng.bio: Sixth Chan patriarch, figure of the Platform Sutra.

thich-chan-that.name: Thích Chân Thật
thich-chan-that.bio: Abbot of Tu Hieu Temple and Thich Nhat Hanh's root teacher.

annamalai-swami.name: Annamalai Swami
annamalai-swami.bio: Ramana Maharshi's attendant and builder who later taught self-enquiry from his small ashram.

gangaji.name: Gangaji
gangaji.bio: American teacher of self-enquiry who met Papaji in 1990.

bhausaheb-maharaj.name: Bhausaheb Maharaj
bhausaheb-maharaj.bio: Founder of the Inchegeri lineage at Inchgiri; teacher of Siddharameshwar.

swami-ram-kashmir.name: Swami Ram (Kashmir)
swami-ram-kashmir.bio: Kashmiri Shaiva master of the late nineteenth century, root of Lakshmanjoo's lineage.

swami-mahtab-kak.name: Swami Mahatab Kak
swami-mahtab-kak.bio: Disciple of Swami Ram and teacher of Swami Lakshmanjoo.

john-hughes.name: John Hughes
john-hughes.bio: Long-time student of Lakshmanjoo who recorded and publishes his teachings.

alexis-sanderson.name: Alexis Sanderson
alexis-sanderson.bio: Oxford Indologist of Shaiva tantra who read texts with Lakshmanjoo.

kshemaraja.name: Kṣemarāja
kshemaraja.bio: Abhinavagupta's leading disciple, author of the Pratyabhijnahrdayam.

vasugupta.name: Vasugupta
vasugupta.bio: Ninth-century sage to whom the Shiva Sutras were revealed.

bhagawan-nityananda.name: Bhagawan Nityananda
bhagawan-nityananda.bio: Avadhuta saint of Ganeshpuri and guru of Muktananda.

muktananda.name: Swami Muktananda
muktananda.bio: Founder of Siddha Yoga, who drew on Kashmir Shaiva texts.

swami-chinmayananda.name: Swami Chinmayananda
swami-chinmayananda.bio: Vedanta teacher who founded Chinmaya Mission and taught Swami Dayananda.

swami-brahmananda.name: Swami Brahmananda
swami-brahmananda.bio: Direct disciple of Ramakrishna and first president of the Ramakrishna Math and Mission.

thomas-merton.name: Thomas Merton
thomas-merton.bio: Trappist monk of Gethsemani and writer on contemplation and interfaith dialogue.

thomas-keating.name: Thomas Keating
thomas-keating.bio: Trappist abbot who helped develop Centering Prayer.

brother-roger.name: Brother Roger of Taizé
brother-roger.bio: Swiss founder of the ecumenical Taizé Community.

bede-griffiths.name: Bede Griffiths
bede-griffiths.bio: English Benedictine who led Shantivanam ashram and joined Christian and Hindu contemplation.

abhishiktananda.name: Swami Abhishiktananda (Henri Le Saux)
abhishiktananda.bio: French Benedictine who co-founded Shantivanam and was transformed by meeting Ramana.

alexander-von-rospatt.name: Alexander von Rospatt
alexander-von-rospatt.bio: UC Berkeley Buddhologist; co-chair of Christopher Wallis's dissertation committee.

amitabh-trika-school.name: Amitabh (Trika School of Tantra)
amitabh-trika-school.bio: Teacher of the Trika School of Tantra, which posts short teachings and guided meditations on Kashmir Shaivism; lineage not independently verified.

amritananda.name: Guruji Amritananda Natha Saraswati
amritananda.bio: Nuclear physicist (Dr Nishtala Prahlada Sastry, 23 years at TIFR Mumbai) who became a Śrī Vidyā guru and founded the Devipuram temple near Visakhapatnam, known for opening Śrī Vidyā initiation and Śrī Chakra worship to all.

andre-padoux.name: André Padoux
andre-padoux.bio: French diplomat turned CNRS scholar of tantric mantra and speech (Vāc); read Abhinavagupta with Lakshmanjoo in Srinagar in 1958–59.

ben-williams.name: Ben Williams
ben-williams.bio: Scholar-practitioner of Śaiva tantra and Abhinavagupta; frequent guest on yoga-studies podcasts.

bettina-baumer.name: Bettina Sharada Bäumer
bettina-baumer.bio: Austrian-born Indologist living in Varanasi; a student of Swami Lakshmanjoo who lectures on the Vijñāna Bhairava, Śiva Sūtras, Spanda and Netra Tantra and on Abhinavagupta's aesthetics.

bjarne-wernicke-olesen.name: Bjarne Wernicke-Olesen
bjarne-wernicke-olesen.bio: Danish scholar of Śākta and Kubjikā traditions.

bodhinatha-veylanswami.name: Satguru Bodhinatha Veylanswami
bodhinatha-veylanswami.bio: Head of Kauai's Hindu Monastery (Kauai Aadheenam) and publisher of Hinduism Today; successor of Sivaya Subramuniyaswami in the Nandinatha Sampradaya, teaching a monistic Śaiva Siddhānta.

csaba-kiss.name: Csaba Kiss
csaba-kiss.bio: Budapest (ELTE) Indologist; Oxford doctorate on the Matsyendrasaṃhitā, editor of Brahmayāmala volume II.

daniel-odier.name: Daniel Odier
daniel-odier.bio: French writer and teacher of Kashmiri Tantra (Spanda, Kālī practice, Tāṇḍava) and Chan; many uploads are in French, only English ones are kept.

daniela-bevilacqua.name: Daniela Bevilacqua
daniela-bevilacqua.bio: Ethnographer of Hindu ascetics on the Haṭha Yoga Project.

david-gordon-white.name: David Gordon White
david-gordon-white.bio: UCSB historian of religions (PhD Chicago 1988) known for The Alchemical Body, Kiss of the Yoginī and Sinister Yogis.

dominic-goodall.name: Dominic Goodall
dominic-goodall.bio: Sanskritist at the École française d'Extrême-Orient (head of its Pondicherry centre 2002–2011); editor of early Śaiva Siddhānta texts such as the Kiraṇavṛtti and the Niśvāsatattvasaṃhitā.

douglas-brooks.name: Douglas Brooks
douglas-brooks.bio: Professor of religion at the University of Rochester (PhD Harvard) and founder of the Rajanaka teaching, rooted in South Indian Śrī Vidyā as learned from his teacher Gopala Aiyar Sundaramoorthy.

edwin-bryant.name: Edwin Bryant
edwin-bryant.bio: Rutgers scholar of the Yoga Sūtras and Bhāgavata Purāṇa.

elizabeth-de-michelis.name: Elizabeth De Michelis
elizabeth-de-michelis.bio: Cambridge scholar of modern yoga (A History of Modern Yoga); supervised Mark Singleton.

eric-baret.name: Éric Baret
eric-baret.bio: French teacher in the line of Jean Klein who presents Kashmir Shaivism as a non-dual, body-based listening.

gavin-flood.name: Gavin Flood
gavin-flood.bio: Oxford scholar of Hinduism and comparative religion; author of The Tantric Body and studies of the Netra Tantra and Śaiva theology.

gopala-aiyar-sundaramoorthy.name: Gopala Aiyar Sundaramoorthy ("Appa")
gopala-aiyar-sundaramoorthy.bio: Sanskrit professor at Madurai-Kamaraj University and teacher of Douglas Brooks; source of the Rajanaka teaching.

gorakhnath.name: Gorakhnāth (Gorakṣanātha)
gorakhnath.bio: Founder-figure of the Nāth yogīs, credited with haṭha texts such as the Amaraugha.

harunaga-isaacson.name: Harunaga Isaacson
harunaga-isaacson.bio: Professor of Classical Indology at Hamburg, specialist in Indian Vajrayāna Buddhism and its links with tantric Śaivism.

igor-kufayev.name: Igor Kufayev
igor-kufayev.bio: Russian-born, Europe-based teacher whose darshans and courses draw heavily on Kashmir Shaivism (Trika, Krama, Spanda) and on kundalini as the process of awakening.

jaideva-singh.name: Jaideva Singh
jaideva-singh.bio: Indian scholar whose English translations of the Pratyabhijñāhṛdayam, Śiva Sūtras, Spanda Kārikās and Vijñāna Bhairava made Kashmir Shaivism widely readable; worked closely with Lakshmanjoo.

james-mallinson.name: James Mallinson
james-mallinson.bio: Boden Professor of Sanskrit at Oxford and leader of the Haṭha Yoga Project; edited the Khecarīvidyā, Dattātreyayogaśāstra and Amṛtasiddhi; also an initiated Rāmānandī mahant.

jason-birch.name: Jason Birch
jason-birch.bio: Historian of medieval yoga on the Haṭha Yoga Project; editor of the Amanaska, Amaraugha and Yogacintāmaṇi.

judit-torzsok.name: Judit Törzsök
judit-torzsok.bio: Professor of Śaiva Studies at the EPHE, Paris; works on early Śākta tantras such as the Siddhayogeśvarīmata and on yoginī cults.

kavitha-chinnaiyan.name: Kavitha Chinnaiyan
kavitha-chinnaiyan.bio: Cardiologist and teacher of Śrī Vidyā and Advaita (Svatantra Institute).

lakulisha.name: Lakulīśa
lakulisha.bio: Traditional founder of the Pāśupata ascetic order, the earliest named Śaiva movement (Atimārga).

lilian-silburn.name: Lilian Silburn
lilian-silburn.bio: French CNRS Indologist who studied Trika with Lakshmanjoo from 1949 and published French translations of the Vijñāna Bhairava, Śiva Sūtras and (with Padoux) the Tantrāloka.

loriliai-biernacki.name: Loriliai Biernacki
loriliai-biernacki.bio: Scholar of Hindu tantra (University of Colorado Boulder) writing on women in tantra, Abhinavagupta, wonder and new materialism.

lorin-roche.name: Lorin Roche
lorin-roche.bio: Meditation teacher known for The Radiance Sutras, a free poetic rendering of the Vijñāna Bhairava.

louis-renou.name: Louis Renou
louis-renou.bio: French Vedic scholar who directed Lilian Silburn's thesis and taught André Padoux Sanskrit.

mark-dyczkowski.name: Mark Dyczkowski
mark-dyczkowski.bio: English Indologist and sitarist in Varanasi, initiated by Lakshmanjoo in 1976; translator of the Spanda texts, the 11-volume Tantrāloka and the Manthānabhairava Tantra.

mark-singleton.name: Mark Singleton
mark-singleton.bio: Scholar of modern and premodern yoga (Yoga Body, Roots of Yoga with Mallinson); senior researcher on the Haṭha Yoga Project.

mary-reilly-nichols.name: Mary Reilly Nichols
mary-reilly-nichols.bio: Yoga and meditation teacher formed in Siddha Yoga who teaches Kashmir Shaivism.

matsyendranatha.name: Matsyendranātha
matsyendranatha.bio: Legendary founder of the Kaula yoginī cult and first guru of the Nāth lineage.

om-swami.name: Om Swami
om-swami.bio: Indian monk and author who teaches mantra sādhana and Śrī Vidyā; many talks are in Hindi, so only English uploads were kept.

paul-muller-ortega.name: Paul Muller-Ortega
paul-muller-ortega.bio: Scholar of Indian religions (PhD, University of California) who taught at Michigan State and Rochester for 25 years, then founded Blue Throat Yoga (2006) to teach Neelakantha Meditation from the Śaiva–Śākta tradition of Kashmir.

rajarshi-nandy.name: Rajarshi Nandy
rajarshi-nandy.bio: Indian upāsaka of Bhairava, Kālī and Kāmākhyā who founded the Kamakhya Bhairava Upasaka Foundation (KBUF); speaks in English, sometimes mixed with Hindi, on Shākta sādhana.

rajmani-tigunait.name: Pandit Rajmani Tigunait
rajmani-tigunait.bio: Spiritual head of the Himalayan Institute and successor of Swami Rama; Sanskritist who teaches Śrī Vidyā, the Śrī Sūkta and tantric mantra practice.

richard-gombrich.name: Richard Gombrich
richard-gombrich.bio: Oxford Indologist and Buddhologist; supervised Mark Dyczkowski's doctorate.

robert-goldman.name: Robert P. Goldman
robert-goldman.bio: UC Berkeley Sanskritist; co-chair of Christopher Wallis's dissertation committee.

sadhguru.name: Sadhguru (Jaggi Vasudev)
sadhguru.bio: Founder of the Isha Foundation; consecrated the Linga Bhairavi goddess form at Coimbatore and teaches Bhairavi Sadhana as a devotional practice open to lay people.

sally-kempton.name: Sally Kempton
sally-kempton.bio: Journalist turned monastic in Swami Muktananda's Siddha Yoga (met Muktananda in 1974; initiated as Swami Durgananda in 1982); later an independent teacher of meditation, Kashmir Shaivism and goddess practice (Awakening Shakti, Meditation for the Love of It).

seth-powell.name: Seth Powell
seth-powell.bio: Historian of yoga and founder of the Yogic Studies platform and podcast.

shaman-hatley.name: Shaman Hatley
shaman-hatley.bio: Scholar of early tantric Śaivism and yoginī cults (UMass Boston); editor of the Brahmayāmala.

shambhavi-sarasvati.name: Shambhavi Sarasvati
shambhavi-sarasvati.bio: Spiritual director of Jaya Kula in Portland, Oregon, teaching Trika Shaivism alongside Tibetan Dzogchen; Anandamayi Ma is her root guru.

sivaya-subramuniyaswami.name: Satguru Sivaya Subramuniyaswami (Gurudeva)
sivaya-subramuniyaswami.bio: American-born founder of Kauai's Hindu Monastery and Himalayan Academy, initiated by Yogaswami of Jaffna; author of Dancing with Siva and Merging with Siva.

somadeva-vasudeva.name: Somadeva Vasudeva
somadeva-vasudeva.bio: Professor at Kyoto University; his Oxford doctorate edited the yoga chapters of the Mālinīvijayottaratantra; works on esoteric Śaiva yoga and Sanskrit poetics.

somananda.name: Somānanda
somananda.bio: Author of the Śivadṛṣṭi, first philosophical statement of non-dual Śaivism in Kashmir; teacher of Utpaladeva.

sravana-borkataky-varma.name: Sravana Borkataky-Varma
sravana-borkataky-varma.bio: Scholar of Śākta tantra in Assam and of women practitioners.

sthaneshwar-timalsina.name: Sthaneshwar Timalsina
sthaneshwar-timalsina.bio: Nepali-born scholar-practitioner (San Diego State University) who teaches Śākta and Śaiva tantra through his Vimarsha Foundation.

swami-khecaranatha.name: Swami Khecaranatha
swami-khecaranatha.bio: American teacher in the line of Swami Rudrananda (Rudi) who teaches Trika Shaivism and kundalini practice through his Heart of Consciousness community.

swami-rama.name: Swami Rama
swami-rama.bio: Founder of the Himalayan Institute and teacher of Pandit Rajmani Tigunait.

swami-rudrananda.name: Swami Rudrananda (Rudi)
swami-rudrananda.bio: American teacher of kundalini practice, root of Swami Khecaranatha's line.

swami-shankarananda.name: Swami Shankarananda
swami-shankarananda.bio: Disciple of Swami Muktananda who founded the Shiva Ashram near Melbourne; teaches Kashmir Shaivism and his own self-inquiry method, the Shiva Process.

tilmann-vetter.name: Tilmann Vetter
tilmann-vetter.bio: Leiden Indologist; supervised Harunaga Isaacson's doctorate.

utpaladeva.name: Utpaladeva
utpaladeva.bio: Author of the Īśvarapratyabhijñākārikā, the founding text of the Recognition (Pratyabhijñā) school; student of Somānanda.

yamajit.name: Yamajit
yamajit.bio: Teacher at the Tridevi Chamunda Mandir who streams long satsangs on the twelve Kālīs of the Krama, the Mātṛkās, the 64 Yoginīs and Vijñāna Bhairava meditations.

yogaswami.name: Yogaswami of Jaffna
yogaswami.bio: Sri Lankan Tamil Śaiva sage, guru of Sivaya Subramuniyaswami.

ajahn-brahmali.name: Ajahn Brahmali
ajahn-brahmali.bio: Norwegian-born monk trained under Ajahn Brahm at Bodhinyana; teaches the early suttas and Vinaya closely, often co-teaching sutta courses with Bhante Sujato.

bhante-sujato.name: Bhante Sujato
bhante-sujato.bio: Australian monk ordained in the Ajahn Chah tradition; founder of Santi Forest Monastery and co-founder of SuttaCentral, where he has published free English translations of the four main Nikāyas.

freeTexts.title: SuttaCentral translations (Sujato; Brahmali Vinaya)

ajahn-hasapanna.name: Ajahn Hasapanna
ajahn-hasapanna.bio: Monk of the Bodhinyana / BSWA community in Western Australia, a student of Ajahn Brahm.

ajahn-nyaniko.name: Ajahn Ñāṇiko
ajahn-nyaniko.bio: Senior monk at Abhayagiri Buddhist Monastery in the Ajahn Chah tradition; gives many of the monastery's evening and retreat talks.

ajahn-karunadhammo.name: Ajahn Karuṇadhammo
ajahn-karunadhammo.bio: American monk of the Ajahn Chah tradition and former abbot of Abhayagiri.

ajahn-cunda.name: Ajahn Cunda
ajahn-cunda.bio: Monk of Abhayagiri Buddhist Monastery in the Ajahn Chah tradition.

ajahn-sudhiro.name: Ajahn Sudhīro
ajahn-sudhiro.bio: Monk of Abhayagiri Buddhist Monastery in the Ajahn Chah tradition.

ajahn-ahimsako.name: Ajahn Ahiṃsako
ajahn-ahimsako.bio: Monk of Cittaviveka (Chithurst) Buddhist Monastery in the Ajahn Chah tradition.

ajahn-karuniko.name: Ajahn Karuniko
ajahn-karuniko.bio: Senior monk at Cittaviveka (Chithurst) in the Ajahn Chah tradition.

ajahn-sona.name: Ajahn Sona
ajahn-sona.bio: Canadian monk and co-founder of Birken Forest Monastery in British Columbia, in the Thai forest tradition; known for practical talks on jhāna and daily life.

ajahn-anan.name: Ajahn Anan
ajahn-anan.bio: Thai monk who ordained under Ajahn Chah in 1975 and founded Wat Marp Jan in Rayong; teaches weekly in Thai with English translation.

ajahn-kalyano.name: Ajahn Kalyano
ajahn-kalyano.bio: Australian monk, a long-time student and translator of Ajahn Anan; abbot of Buddha Bodhivana Monastery near Melbourne.

ajahn-chandako.name: Ajahn Chandako
ajahn-chandako.bio: American-born monk of the Ajahn Chah tradition; abbot of Vimutti Buddhist Monastery in New Zealand.

sayadaw-u-silananda.name: Sayadaw U Sīlānanda
sayadaw-u-silananda.bio: Burmese scholar-monk trained in the Mahasi tradition; founded the Theravada Buddhist Society of America and taught Abhidhamma and satipaṭṭhāna in California.

sayadaw-u-thuzana.name: Sayadaw U Thuzana
sayadaw-u-thuzana.bio: Burmese teacher in the Mahasi lineage who leads retreats at the Tathagata Meditation Center.

sayadaw-u-nandasiri.name: Sayadaw U Nandasiri
sayadaw-u-nandasiri.bio: Burmese teacher in the Mahasi lineage who leads retreats at the Tathagata Meditation Center.

bhikkhu-analayo.name: Bhikkhu Anālayo
bhikkhu-analayo.bio: German-born monk and scholar ordained in Sri Lanka; specialist in comparative study of the Pāli Nikāyas and Chinese Āgamas, and author of widely used books on satipaṭṭhāna.

swami-pavitrananda.name: Swami Pavitrananda
swami-pavitrananda.bio: Monk of the Ramakrishna Order who led the Vedanta Society of New York from 1951; heard here in archival recordings.

swami-tathagatananda.name: Swami Tathagatananda
swami-tathagatananda.bio: Monk of the Ramakrishna Order and long-time head of the Vedanta Society of New York; heard here in archival recordings.

swami-dhyanayogananda.name: Swami Dhyanayogananda
swami-dhyanayogananda.bio: Monk of the Ramakrishna Order at the Vedanta Society of Southern California.

swami-medhananda.name: Swami Medhananda (Ayon Maharaj)
swami-medhananda.bio: Monk of the Ramakrishna Order and philosopher (Ayon Maharaj), author of studies of Ramakrishna's and Vivekananda's philosophy.

pravrajika-vrajaprana.name: Pravrajika Vrajaprana
pravrajika-vrajaprana.bio: Nun of the Sarada Convent (Vedanta Society of Southern California) and author of books on Vedanta.

pravrajika-krishnaprana.name: Pravrajika Krishnaprana
pravrajika-krishnaprana.bio: Nun of the Sarada Convent, Vedanta Society of Southern California.

swami-tyagananda.name: Swami Tyagananda
swami-tyagananda.bio: Monk of the Ramakrishna Order, head of the Ramakrishna Vedanta Society of Boston and Hindu chaplain at Harvard and MIT.

swami-chetanananda.name: Swami Chetanananda
swami-chetanananda.bio: Monk of the Ramakrishna Order, minister of the Vedanta Society of St. Louis and author of histories of Ramakrishna's disciples.

swami-shivarchanananda.name: Swami Shivarchanananda
swami-shivarchanananda.bio: Monk of the Ramakrishna Order at the Vedanta Society of St. Louis.

swami-ishatmananda.name: Swami Ishatmananda
swami-ishatmananda.bio: Monk of the Ramakrishna Order and head of the Vivekananda Vedanta Society of Chicago.

swami-tejomayananda.name: Swami Tejomayananda
swami-tejomayananda.bio: Disciple of Swami Chinmayananda and former head of the Chinmaya Mission worldwide.

swami-swaroopananda-chinmaya.name: Swami Swaroopananda (Chinmaya Mission)
swami-swaroopananda-chinmaya.bio: Disciple of Swami Chinmayananda and current global head of the Chinmaya Mission.

swamini-svatmavidyananda.name: Swamini Svatmavidyananda
swamini-svatmavidyananda.bio: Traditional teacher of Vedānta in the line of Swami Dayananda Saraswati.

swami-tattvavidananda.name: Swami Tattvavidananda
swami-tattvavidananda.bio: Senior disciple of Swami Dayananda Saraswati teaching Vedānta and Sanskrit.

swami-viditatmananda.name: Swami Viditatmananda
swami-viditatmananda.bio: Senior disciple of Swami Dayananda Saraswati, long associated with the Arsha Vidya Gurukulam.

radhanath-swami.name: Radhanath Swami
radhanath-swami.bio: American-born Gaudiya Vaishnava teacher in ISKCON, a disciple of A. C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada, and author of "The Journey Home".

swami-niranjanananda.name: Swami Niranjanananda Saraswati
swami-niranjanananda.bio: Successor of Swami Satyananda Saraswati and long-time head of the Bihar School of Yoga in Munger.

swami-swaroopananda-sivananda.name: Swami Swaroopananda (Sivananda)
swami-swaroopananda-sivananda.bio: Senior acharya of the Sivananda Yoga Vedanta Centres, a disciple of Swami Vishnudevananda.

swami-sitaramananda.name: Swami Sitaramananda
swami-sitaramananda.bio: Acharya of the Sivananda Yoga Farm in California, a disciple of Swami Vishnudevananda.

swami-paramananda-sivananda.name: Swami Paramananda (Sivananda)
swami-paramananda-sivananda.bio: Teacher of the Sivananda Yoga Vedanta Centres (not the Ramakrishna-order Swami Paramananda, 1884–1940).

swami-shambhudevananda.name: Swami Shambhudevananda
swami-shambhudevananda.bio: Teacher of the Sivananda Yoga Vedanta Centres.

swami-brahmananda-sivananda.name: Swami Brahmananda (Sivananda)
swami-brahmananda-sivananda.bio: Teacher of the Sivananda Yoga Vedanta Centres (not the Ramakrishna-order Swami Brahmananda).

ajahn-dtun.name: Ajahn Dtun
ajahn-dtun.bio: Thai monk ordained at Wat Nong Pah Pong with Ajahn Chah as preceptor (1978); trained with Ajahn Piak and Ajahn Anan and founded Wat Boonyawad in Chonburi.

freeTexts.title: The Autobiography and Dhamma Teachings of Ajahn Dtun

alexander-wynne.name: Alexander Wynne
alexander-wynne.bio: British scholar of early Buddhism; Oxford DPhil under Richard Gombrich, author of "The Origin of Buddhist Meditation", and an editor of the Journal of the OCBS.

rupert-gethin.name: Rupert Gethin
rupert-gethin.bio: British scholar of the Nikāyas and Abhidhamma, emeritus professor at Bristol and president of the Pali Text Society; PhD at Manchester under Lance Cousins.

steven-collins.name: Steven Collins
steven-collins.bio: British scholar of Pāli Buddhism at Chicago, author of "Selfless Persons" and "Nirvana and Other Buddhist Felicities"; Oxford DPhil under Richard Gombrich.

jeffery-long.name: Jeffery D. Long
jeffery-long.bio: American scholar of Hindu and Jain traditions at Elizabethtown College, closely associated with the Vedanta Societies.

tkv-desikachar.name: T. K. V. Desikachar
tkv-desikachar.bio: Son and student of T. Krishnamacharya; founded the Krishnamacharya Yoga Mandiram in Chennai and taught yoga adapted to the individual.

wendy-doniger.name: Wendy Doniger
wendy-doniger.bio: American Indologist at the University of Chicago, translator of Sanskrit texts and author of "The Hindus: An Alternative History".

nick-sutton.name: Nicholas Sutton
nick-sutton.bio: Scholar of the Mahābhārata and Bhagavad Gītā who teaches the OCHS online courses.

lance-cousins.name: Lance Cousins
lance-cousins.bio: British scholar of Pāli and Abhidhamma (Manchester, Oxford) and samatha meditation teacher; supervised Rupert Gethin.

paul-williams.name: Paul Williams
paul-williams.bio: British scholar of Mahāyāna Buddhism at Bristol; taught Alexander Wynne and introduced Steven Collins to Gombrich.

katukurunde-nanananda.name: Katukurunde Ñāṇananda
katukurunde-nanananda.bio: Sri Lankan forest monk and author of "Concept and Reality" and the "Nibbāna – The Mind Stilled" sermons.

balangoda-ananda-maitreya.name: Balangoda Ānanda Maitreya
balangoda-ananda-maitreya.bio: Sri Lankan scholar-monk who was Bhikkhu Bodhi's preceptor.

ajahn-piak.name: Ajahn Piak
ajahn-piak.bio: Thai disciple of Ajahn Chah and abbot of Wat Pah Cittabhavana; Ajahn Dtun and Ajahn Anan trained alongside him.

tapovan-maharaj.name: Swami Tapovan Maharaj
tapovan-maharaj.bio: Himalayan Vedānta master at Uttarkashi; Swami Chinmayananda's teacher.

swami-vishnudevananda.name: Swami Vishnudevananda
swami-vishnudevananda.bio: Disciple of Swami Sivananda who founded the Sivananda Yoga Vedanta Centres.

swami-satyananda.name: Swami Satyananda Saraswati
swami-satyananda.bio: Disciple of Swami Sivananda who founded the Bihar School of Yoga (1963).

krishnamacharya.name: T. Krishnamacharya
krishnamacharya.bio: South Indian yoga teacher whose students (Desikachar, Iyengar, Pattabhi Jois, Indra Devi) shaped modern postural yoga.

bks-iyengar.name: B. K. S. Iyengar
bks-iyengar.bio: Student and brother-in-law of Krishnamacharya; founder of Iyengar Yoga.

pattabhi-jois.name: K. Pattabhi Jois
pattabhi-jois.bio: Student of Krishnamacharya; founder of Ashtanga Vinyasa Yoga in Mysore.

chaitanya-mahaprabhu.name: Chaitanya Mahāprabhu
chaitanya-mahaprabhu.bio: Bengali saint whose ecstatic Krishna devotion founded the Gaudiya Vaishnava tradition.

bhaktisiddhanta.name: Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī
bhaktisiddhanta.bio: Founder of the Gaudiya Math and guru of A. C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada.

bhaktivedanta-swami-prabhupada.name: A. C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupāda
bhaktivedanta-swami-prabhupada.bio: Founder of ISKCON (1966), who brought Gaudiya Vaishnavism to the West.

daniel-ingalls.name: Daniel H. H. Ingalls
daniel-ingalls.bio: Harvard Sanskritist; supervised Wendy Doniger's Harvard PhD.

swami-paramarthananda.name: Swami Paramarthananda
swami-paramarthananda.bio: Chennai-based disciple of Swami Dayananda, known for systematic English Vedānta classes (no official YouTube channel found).

dzogchen-ponlop.name: Dzogchen Ponlop Rinpoche
dzogchen-ponlop.bio: Kagyu and Nyingma lama, founder of Nalandabodhi, who presents mind training and the "mindful gap" to modern audiences with humour and an interest in art and popular culture.

ringu-tulku.name: Ringu Tulku Rinpoche
ringu-tulku.bio: Karma Kagyu lama and scholar of the Rimé movement, former professor of Tibetan studies in Sikkim, who founded Bodhicharya and teaches in a light, accessible style.

tenzin-wangyal.name: Tenzin Wangyal Rinpoche
tenzin-wangyal.bio: Bön lama trained at Menri under Lopön Tenzin Namdak, founder of Ligmincha International, who teaches Bön Dzogchen, dream yoga and the healing practices of sound and breath.

valerie-forstman.name: Valerie Forstman
valerie-forstman.bio: Associate Zen Master of the Sanbo Zen lineage and guiding teacher of Mountain Cloud Zen Center, first a student of Ruben Habito.

chigan-roshi.name: Chigan Roshi
chigan-roshi.bio: Rinzai Zen teacher with the Zen Studies Society who gives teisho on koan collections at Dai Bosatsu Zendo and New York Zendo.

jeffrey-hopkins.name: Jeffrey Hopkins
jeffrey-hopkins.bio: Scholar and translator of Gelug Madhyamaka and tantra, founder of the Tibetan Buddhist studies doctoral programme at the University of Virginia and the Dalai Lama's chief English interpreter 1979–89.

lama-jampa-thaye.name: Lama Jampa Thaye
lama-jampa-thaye.bio: British-born lama authorised in the Sakya and Karma Kagyu traditions by Karma Thinley Rinpoche, founder of the Dechen community and a scholar of Tibetan Buddhism.

kwan-um-school.name: Kwan Um School of Zen (various Zen Masters)
kwan-um-school.bio: The Kwan Um School of Zen, the international Korean Seon school founded by Zen Master Seung Sahn; the channel collects short talks by many of its Zen Masters.

tendai-buddhist-institute.name: Tendai Buddhist Institute (weekly dharma talks)
tendai-buddhist-institute.bio: Tendai Buddhist Institute in New York state, the American branch of Japanese Tendai; its weekly Wednesday talks cover Tiantai/Tendai doctrine and practice.

shingon-foundation.name: Foundation for Shingon Buddhism (classes and podcast)
shingon-foundation.bio: Foundation for Shingon Buddhism, which shares Shingon esoteric Buddhism, its texts and Koyasan culture in English.

dzongsar-khyentse.name: Dzongsar Jamyang Khyentse Rinpoche
dzongsar-khyentse.bio: Bhutanese Rimé lama of the Sakya and Nyingma lines, recognised as an incarnation of Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo; filmmaker, author and founder of Siddhartha's Intent and Khyentse Foundation.

alan-wallace.name: B. Alan Wallace
alan-wallace.bio: American scholar-practitioner ordained by the Dalai Lama and trained by Geshe Rabten, later a Stanford PhD, who teaches shamatha and Dzogchen and argues for a "contemplative science" of mind.

khentrul-rinpoche.name: Khentrul Rinpoche
khentrul-rinpoche.bio: Shar Khentrul Jamphel Lodrö, a Jonang master trained in a non-sectarian (Rimé) way, who teaches Kalachakra and the shentong "other-emptiness" view through Dzokden.

robert-thurman.name: Robert A. F. Thurman
robert-thurman.bio: American scholar and translator, the first Westerner ordained a Tibetan Buddhist monk, Jey Tsong Khapa Professor at Columbia and co-founder of Tibet House US; died in June 2026.

sheng-yen.name: Master Sheng Yen
sheng-yen.bio: Taiwanese Chan master of the Linji and Caodong lines and founder of Dharma Drum Mountain, who revived Chan practice and taught in the West; his Great Dharma Drum TV series answers short questions.

dzigar-kongtrul.name: Dzigar Kongtrul Rinpoche
dzigar-kongtrul.bio: Nyingma lama, son of Neten Chokling Rinpoche and former professor at Naropa, founder of Mangala Shri Bhuti, and teacher of Pema Chödrön.

hokuto-sensei.name: Hokuto Daniel Diffin
hokuto-sensei.bio: Rinzai Zen priest with the Zen Studies Society (Hokuto Osho) who gives Dharma talks on the Record of Linji.

anne-klein.name: Anne C. Klein (Lama Rigzin Drolma)
anne-klein.bio: Professor of Religious Studies at Rice University and, as Lama Rigzin Drolma, co-founder of Dawn Mountain in Houston, teaching Nyingma Dzogchen.

thupten-jinpa.name: Thupten Jinpa
thupten-jinpa.bio: Former Gelug monk with a Geshe Lharampa degree and a Cambridge PhD, principal English translator to the Dalai Lama since 1985, Tsongkhapa biographer and author of the Compassion Cultivation Training programme.

jundo-cohen.name: Jundo Cohen
jundo-cohen.bio: American Soto Zen priest living in Japan, Dharma heir of Gudo Wafu Nishijima and founder of the online Treeleaf Zendo.

tsultrim-allione.name: Lama Tsultrim Allione
tsultrim-allione.bio: American teacher, one of the first Western women ordained in Tibetan Buddhism (1970), founder of Tara Mandala and author of Women of Wisdom and Feeding Your Demons, a modern adaptation of Chöd.

chozen-bays.name: Jan Chozen Bays
chozen-bays.bio: Jan Chozen Bays, Dharma heir of Taizan Maezumi, paediatrician and co-abbot of Great Vow Zen Monastery in Oregon.

meian-elbert.name: Rev. Meian Elbert
meian-elbert.bio: Abbess of Shasta Abbey in the Order of Buddhist Contemplatives founded by Houn Jiyu-Kennett.

jiryu-rutschman-byler.name: Jiryu Rutschman-Byler
jiryu-rutschman-byler.bio: Soto Zen priest and former abbot of Green Gulch Farm, San Francisco Zen Center.

anam-thubten.name: Anam Thubten
anam-thubten.bio: Tibetan teacher trained in the Nyingma tradition who leads the Dharmata Foundation in California and teaches a direct, non-sectarian approach to awakening.

phakchok-rinpoche.name: Phakchok Rinpoche
phakchok-rinpoche.bio: Nyingma and Kagyu lineage holder, grandson of Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche, abbot of Ka-Nying Shedrub Ling and founder of the Samye Institute.

guo-gu.name: Guo Gu
guo-gu.bio: Guo Gu (Jimmy Yu), Dharma heir of Master Sheng Yen and professor of religion at Florida State University, who teaches silent illumination and huatou at the Tallahassee Chan Center.

david-germano.name: David Germano
david-germano.bio: Professor of Tibetan and Buddhist Studies at the University of Virginia, a historian of the Great Perfection (Dzogchen) and founder of the Tibetan and Himalayan Library and UVA's Contemplative Sciences Center.

barry-magid.name: Barry Magid
barry-magid.bio: Psychiatrist and Dharma heir of Charlotte Joko Beck who founded Ordinary Mind Zendo in New York.

elizabeth-mattis-namgyel.name: Elizabeth Mattis Namgyel
elizabeth-mattis-namgyel.bio: American teacher in the Nyingma line of Dzigar Kongtrul Rinpoche, author of The Power of an Open Question, who explores Madhyamaka "not knowing" in daily life.

lama-lena.name: Lama Lena
lama-lena.bio: American teacher (Yeshe Kaytup) of Dzogchen and Mahamudra, a long-time student of Wangdor Rinpoche, known for informal, precise "direct mind perception" teachings streamed from many cities.

shenpen-hookham.name: Lama Shenpen Hookham
shenpen-hookham.bio: British Kagyu and Nyingma teacher, Oxford DPhil on shentong buddha-nature, founder of the Awakened Heart Sangha.

phap-hai.name: Brother Phap Hai
phap-hai.bio: Plum Village monastic (Brother Pháp Hải), Dharma teacher in Thich Nhat Hanh's tradition.

kokyo-henkel.name: Kokyo Henkel
kokyo-henkel.bio: Soto Zen priest from the San Francisco Zen Center lineage, guiding teacher of Santa Cruz Zen Center, with a strong interest in buddha-nature texts.

jetsunma-tenzin-palmo.name: Jetsunma Tenzin Palmo
jetsunma-tenzin-palmo.bio: British-born Drukpa Kagyu nun who spent twelve years in a Himalayan cave and founded Dongyu Gatsal Ling nunnery.

tulku-thondup.name: Tulku Thondup Rinpoche
tulku-thondup.bio: Nyingma scholar trained at Dodrupchen monastery, former visiting scholar at Harvard, author of books on healing, the Longchen Nyingthig and the hidden treasure (terma) tradition.

lama-rod-owens.name: Lama Rod Owens
lama-rod-owens.bio: Black, queer Kagyu lama who completed a three-year retreat under Lama Norlha Rinpoche; teaches on anger, healing and collective liberation and leads Medicine Buddha practice online.

menri-trizin.name: 34th Menri Trizin
menri-trizin.bio: The 34th Menri Trizin, abbot of Menri Monastery in Dolanji and spiritual head of the Bön tradition, successor to Lungtok Tenpai Nyima (d. 2017).

willa-blythe-baker.name: Lama Willa Blythe Baker
willa-blythe-baker.bio: Kagyu lineage holder authorised after two three-year retreats, Harvard PhD (2013) and founder of Natural Dharma Fellowship and Wonderwell Mountain Refuge; teaches somatic mindfulness and Mahamudra.

jan-willis.name: Jan Willis
jan-willis.bio: Professor emerita of religion at Wesleyan and long-time student of Lama Thubten Yeshe, who writes on Tibetan hagiography, women and race in Buddhism.

reb-anderson.name: Tenshin Reb Anderson
reb-anderson.bio: Senior Dharma teacher at San Francisco Zen Center, ordained by Shunryu Suzuki, known for close readings of Dogen and the bodhisattva precepts.

paul-swanson.name: Paul L. Swanson
paul-swanson.bio: Scholar and translator of Tiantai at the Nanzan Institute for Religion and Culture, translator of Zhiyi's Mohe zhiguan (Clear Serenity, Quiet Insight).

donald-lopez.name: Donald S. Lopez Jr.
donald-lopez.bio: Arthur E. Link Distinguished University Professor at Michigan, a historian of Tibetan Buddhism and of the Western reception of Buddhism.

dae-bong.name: Zen Master Dae Bong
dae-bong.bio: American Zen Master in Seung Sahn's Kwan Um School, guiding teacher at Hwagyesa International Zen Center in Seoul.

duncan-williams.name: Duncan Ryūken Williams
duncan-williams.bio: Soto Zen priest and professor at the University of Southern California, author of American Sutra on Japanese American Buddhists in wartime incarceration.

alexander-berzin.name: Alexander Berzin
alexander-berzin.bio: American scholar-translator who studied under Tsenzhab Serkong Rinpoche and the Dalai Lama in Dharamsala and created the Berzin Archives (now Study Buddhism), a large free library of Gelug and comparative teachings.

phap-huu.name: Brother Phap Huu
phap-huu.bio: Plum Village monastic (Brother Pháp Hữu), long-time attendant of Thich Nhat Hanh and abbot of Upper Hamlet.

robert-sharf.name: Robert H. Sharf
robert-sharf.bio: D. H. Chen Distinguished Professor of Buddhist Studies at UC Berkeley, a historian of Chan and Japanese Buddhism and a critic of "meditative experience" rhetoric.

garchen-rinpoche.name: Garchen Rinpoche
garchen-rinpoche.bio: Drikung Kagyu master who spent some twenty years in Chinese labour camps, where he trained under Khenpo Münsel; teaches love and compassion as the heart of Mahamudra through the Garchen Buddhist Institute in Arizona.

sam-van-schaik.name: Sam van Schaik
sam-van-schaik.bio: English Tibetologist at the British Library, author of Tibet: A History, Tibetan Zen and The Spirit of Zen, who works on Dunhuang manuscripts and early Dzogchen.

brook-ziporyn.name: Brook Ziporyn
brook-ziporyn.bio: Mircea Eliade Professor at the University of Chicago Divinity School, philosopher of Tiantai Buddhism and Zhuangzi.

geoffrey-samuel.name: Geoffrey Samuel
geoffrey-samuel.bio: Anthropologist of Tibetan religion, emeritus professor at Cardiff, author of Civilized Shamans and The Origins of Yoga and Tantra.

bernard-faure.name: Bernard Faure
bernard-faure.bio: French historian of Chan/Zen and esoteric Buddhism, emeritus at Columbia and Stanford, trained under Yanagida Seizan in Kyoto.

jacob-dalton.name: Jacob P. Dalton
jacob-dalton.bio: Khyentse Foundation Distinguished Professor of Tibetan Buddhism at UC Berkeley, a historian of tantric ritual, the Nyingma school and the Dunhuang manuscripts.

phap-linh.name: Brother Phap Linh
phap-linh.bio: Plum Village monastic (Brother Pháp Linh), Dharma teacher and musician in Thich Nhat Hanh's tradition.

ruben-habito.name: Ruben Habito
ruben-habito.bio: Filipino former Jesuit, Sanbo Zen teacher authorised in 1988 and founder of Maria Kannon Zen Center in Dallas.

jose-cabezon.name: José Ignacio Cabezón
jose-cabezon.bio: Dalai Lama Professor emeritus at UC Santa Barbara and former monk of Sera, who writes on Gelug and Nyingma philosophy, Sera monastery and Buddhist sexual ethics.

asanga-vajra.name: H.E. Asanga Vajra Rinpoche
asanga-vajra.bio: Sakya lama of the Phuntsok Phodrang line who teaches at Sakya Monastery of Tibetan Buddhism in Seattle.

sakya-trizin.name: Sakya Trizin (41st)
sakya-trizin.bio: Ngawang Kunga, 41st Sakya Trizin, head of the Sakya school for over five decades and now known as Sakya Trichen.

chan-duc.name: Sister Chan Duc (Annabel Laity)
chan-duc.bio: Sister Chân Đức (Annabel Laity), senior English-born Dharma teacher of Plum Village.

seung-sahn.name: Zen Master Seung Sahn
seung-sahn.bio: Korean Seon master of the Jogye order who founded the Kwan Um School of Zen and taught "only don't know".

janet-gyatso.name: Janet Gyatso
janet-gyatso.bio: Hershey Professor of Buddhist Studies at Harvard, a scholar of Tibetan visionary autobiography, medicine and gender.

steven-heine.name: Steven Heine
steven-heine.bio: Scholar of Dogen and Zen koans at Florida International University.

taigen-leighton.name: Taigen Dan Leighton
taigen-leighton.bio: Soto Zen priest and Dharma heir of Tenshin Reb Anderson, translator of Dogen and Hongzhi, guiding teacher of Ancient Dragon Zen Gate in Chicago.

dosho-port.name: Dosho Port
dosho-port.bio: Soto Zen teacher in the Dainin Katagiri line who hosts interviews with Zen teachers.

kenneth-tanaka.name: Kenneth K. Tanaka
kenneth-tanaka.bio: Shin Buddhist priest and scholar, professor emeritus at Musashino University, writing on Pure Land thought and Buddhism in America.

dennis-hirota.name: Dennis Hirota
dennis-hirota.bio: Scholar and translator of Shinran, head translator of the Collected Works of Shinran.

peter-gregory.name: Peter N. Gregory
peter-gregory.bio: Scholar of Chinese Buddhism, author of Tsung-mi and the Sinification of Buddhism, a central study of Huayan and Chan.

richard-payne.name: Richard K. Payne
richard-payne.bio: Scholar of Shingon ritual and tantric Buddhism, long-time dean of the Institute of Buddhist Studies in Berkeley.

john-mcrae.name: John R. McRae
john-mcrae.bio: Historian of early Chinese Chan, author of The Northern School and Seeing through Zen, trained by Stanley Weinstein and Yanagida Seizan.

charles-jones.name: Charles B. Jones
charles-jones.bio: Scholar of Chinese Pure Land and Taiwanese Buddhism at the Catholic University of America, author of Pure Land: History, Tradition, and Practice.

karl-brunnholzl.name: Karl Brunnhölzl
karl-brunnholzl.bio: German physician-turned-scholar and translator of Kagyu texts on Madhyamaka, Mahamudra and buddha-nature.

khenpo-sodargye.name: Khenpo Sodargye
khenpo-sodargye.bio: Nyingma scholar from Larung Gar in eastern Tibet who teaches widely in Chinese.

chan-khong.name: Sister Chan Khong
chan-khong.bio: Vietnamese nun and social worker, Thich Nhat Hanh's closest collaborator in relief work and co-founder of Plum Village.

bodhin-kjolhede.name: Bodhin Kjolhede
bodhin-kjolhede.bio: Abbot of the Rochester Zen Center and Dharma heir of Philip Kapleau.

mark-blum.name: Mark L. Blum
mark-blum.bio: Scholar of Japanese Pure Land Buddhism at UC Berkeley and translator of Honen and the Nirvana Sutra.

griffith-foulk.name: T. Griffith Foulk
griffith-foulk.bio: Scholar of Chan and Zen monastic institutions at Sarah Lawrence College and co-editor of the Soto Zen Text Project.

laurence-freeman.name: Laurence Freeman OSB
laurence-freeman.bio: Benedictine monk, student and successor of John Main, and director of the World Community for Christian Meditation.

iain-mcgilchrist.name: Iain McGilchrist
iain-mcgilchrist.bio: Psychiatrist and philosopher, author of The Master and His Emissary and The Matter with Things, on the hemispheres and the sacred.

bernardo-kastrup.name: Bernardo Kastrup
bernardo-kastrup.bio: Philosopher and computer engineer who argues for analytic idealism, the view that reality is fundamentally mental.

arthur-green.name: Arthur Green
arthur-green.bio: Scholar of Hasidism and neo-Hasidic theologian; doctorate under Alexander Altmann at Brandeis, founding dean of Hebrew College's rabbinical school.

pir-zia-inayat-khan.name: Pir Zia Inayat Khan
pir-zia-inayat-khan.bio: Head of the Inayatiyya since 2004, grandson of Hazrat Inayat Khan and founder of Suluk Academy; PhD in religion from Duke.

omid-safi.name: Omid Safi
omid-safi.bio: Duke University scholar of Islam who teaches Rumi, radical love and Sufi practice through his own courses and talks.

hisham-kabbani.name: Shaykh Muhammad Hisham Kabbani
hisham-kabbani.bio: Lebanese-American Naqshbandi-Haqqani shaykh, deputy and son-in-law of Shaykh Nazim, who founded the order's centres in North America.

nour-kabbani.name: Shaykh Dr. Nour Kabbani
nour-kabbani.bio: Naqshbandi teacher, son and successor of Shaykh Hisham Kabbani and grandson of Shaykh Nazim.

baraka-blue.name: Baraka Blue
baraka-blue.bio: Poet and teacher at the Rumi Center whose series Mirror of the Infinite teaches Rumi's Masnavi and the Sufi path of the heart.

father-spyridon.name: Father Spyridon
father-spyridon.bio: Orthodox priest who teaches the Jesus Prayer, repentance and the ascetic teaching of the Fathers in short talks.

angela-puca.name: Angela Puca
angela-puca.bio: Scholar of Western esotericism and magic who runs Angela's Symposium, an academic channel on theurgy, Hermetic magic and the grimoire tradition.

john-main.name: John Main OSB
john-main.bio: Irish Benedictine who recovered mantra meditation from John Cassian and the desert tradition; founding inspiration of the WCCM.

moshe-idel.name: Moshe Idel
moshe-idel.bio: Hebrew University scholar of Kabbalah who reframed the field around ecstatic Kabbalah and Abraham Abulafia.

nimatullahi-order.name: Nimatullahi Sufi Order
nimatullahi-order.bio: Official channel of the Nimatullahi order: illustrated classical Sufi teaching stories.

william-rowlandson.name: William Rowlandson
william-rowlandson.bio: Scholar of Borges, Swedenborg and the imaginal who supported the Kent MA in Myth, Cosmology and the Sacred.

angela-voss.name: Angela Voss
angela-voss.bio: Scholar of Marsilio Ficino and the symbolic imagination who created the Kent and Canterbury MAs in Myth, Cosmology and the Sacred with Geoffrey Cornelius.

sarah-bachelard.name: Sarah Bachelard
sarah-bachelard.bio: Australian Anglican priest and theologian teaching contemplative Christianity in the WCCM.

becca-tarnas.name: Becca Tarnas
